title: A fixed-size affine seed family for isolated NP queries
claims: MaximumSeedPrefixIsolation proves that for every yes-input at least one eighth of the fixed-size affine seeds have a prefix isolating a verifier witness.
The source verifier, seeded NP query language and no-input soundness use the pinned reference machine and class definitions.
A finite product equivalence proves the exact prefix-fibre count, so the success guarantee does not require choosing the unknown good width in advance.
P_subset_NP is independently checked against pinned definitions.

experiments.purpose: Run the pinned reference checker where available. Otherwise compare source hashes with the submitted checker transcript, without awarding experimental Lean points.
